lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: What's going on, Imposter? LMAO

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I guess you've spent your lifetime supply of luck, huh?
What do you mean?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Can't you see?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: You and I are on the same team together now.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: With the help of the Strongest Shield on the surface,

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: you have no need to worry. I got your back!
I see.
That's great.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: But, what should I do?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I still have a really big concern.
A really big concern?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: You are too weak, Imposter.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I've never seen someone as weak as you on the surface.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: And I can't help you with that.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Do you have any idea?
I'll become stronger in the future.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: But can you really become half as strong as the real Commander?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: or even one-fourth of his strength?
... Take a deep breath, and tell myself to be patient.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: But sometimes,

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: people with perseverance like you

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: may soon achieve whatever they want lol.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: So, I, as the strongest one who breaks the balance of this world,

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: will personally take good care of you

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: and always keep an eye out for you.
I really appreciate that, thx :)

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Huh, you better know how lucky you are.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Unlike you, Imposter, I'm quite busy.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: So, see ya!
... Remember that,
I need to be patient.
